final_grader.about: Every run on the R8 build or later, graded again offline from its own exports by the final grader. T01's grader is at cd49049, which credits a change record that names its change in shorthand (C9); regraded with it, every T01 run from R8 to R14 keeps its row, gate and D12 except the two R14 Astra runs (C9, 0.97 to 1.00). T03's grader is unchanged since 689ab3b; runs through T03R3 were regraded at 9b076a2 and the later grader changes move none of them. A judge row keeps its recorded votes when the final grader sends the judge the same prompt; otherwise it is re-judged once (3 samples) with the final prompt. Only grader changes can move a score: world and colleague fixes can't change what a recorded run did. losses says whose the points a run still loses are: fair (the agent's), env (a world or colleague defect fixed since), or mixed.
